the study of structural and functional alterations in the brain of patients with mTBi while performing hand movements, using fMRI and EEG.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the left hemisphere of the brain is more sensitive to mTbi than the right one, and the brain structures of the young people are the most sensitive to the traumatic brain injury.
fMRI and EEG reactions to hand motor tasks in patients with mild traumatic brain injury are more sensitive to left hemispheric damage.

we have shown a greater sensitivity of the left hemisphere to mTBI, which can be the reason for the left hemispheric dominance in mTBI patients.

we found the most expressed pathological changes in the left hemispheres of mTBI patients.
